Electric-assist bicycles permissible with no more
than 1,000 watts of power and maximum speed
of 20mph with or without assist
Bicycles must obey traffic lights and stop signs
(as well as all other traffic control devices).

Bicycles may treat Stop sign as Yield (but must
obey Stop at RR crossings & school buses).
Bicycles & Pedestrians must follow traffic laws.

Bicycles cannot ride on some limited access
highways.
Bikes forbidden: SR 520, I-405, I-90 (exit 0 to
exit 17), I-5 (Lakewood to Marysville), parts of 18,
518, 522 & 599 and a few others.

A bicycle must yield to a pedestrian on a
sidewalk or crosswalk.

Traffic laws apply on bicycle trails too.
Bicycles have all the same rights and
responsibilites as cars.
A bicycle is a vehicle on the road or a pedestrian
on the sidewalk.
Only one person per bicycle seat.

Bicycles are not required to use a bike lane or
shoulder.
